editorial:
Imagine a summer where everything that can go wrong does, but in the funniest way possible. You follow Ginger and her friends as they head to Camp Caprice, only to be joined by Courtney, a spoiled rich girl who thinks she is too good for the outdoors. The vibe is a total chaotic mess of teenage crushes and outdoor mishaps. While Ginger is trying to make a move on a cute boy named Sasha, Courtney is busy making everything difficult for everyone. It feels like those classic summer vacation movies where the lessons are simple but the laughs are plenty.

What really makes this work is the side plot with Carl and Hoodsey. Their plan to start a vampire dog cleaning service just to catch a thief is absolutely wild and keeps the energy high. The pacing is quick, and while the animation is basic, it fits the goofy tone of the story. If you are looking for something light to watch with the family, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best look, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night.
endingExplained: In the end, Courtney finally learns that being rich does not make her better than others after a series of embarrassing camp accidents. She helps Ginger and Sasha get together, proving she has a heart. Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey successfully use their weird dog cleaning business as a front to trap the dog thief. Everyone returns home with new friends and better attitudes, wrapping up the summer on a happy and surprising note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy animated comedies and summer camp stories.
